en-in.counterQ: Which airline counter should I use?
en-in.counterA: Check the actual operating airline and distinguish check-in, ticketing and arrival baggage services. Confirm the counter on your travel date with the departure screens and the airline.
en-in.routeQ: How do I find routes at this airport?
en-in.routeA: Open a listed route to check its operating dates and schedule validity. Airport-pair links show information for the relevant departure and arrival airports.
en-in.statusQ: Does the timetable show today’s flight status?
en-in.statusA: Scheduled departure and arrival times are separate from flight status on your travel date. Check your flight number and travel date through the airline’s official flight-status link.
en-in.intro: At {name}, check routes between India and Thailand and airline counter information.
